newsitem.title: USA: Sizzler says unit President Ryan resigns.
newsitem.headline: Sizzler says unit President Ryan resigns.

text.p: Sizzler International Inc said Timothy Ryan resigned as president of Sizzler USA in conjunction with the company's consolidation of international and domestic responsibilities.
Kevin Perkins, Sizzler International president and chief executive officer, will head Sizzler's domestic business.
Ryan will continue as a consultant to Sizzler management.

"In developing our plan to reorganize our business and emerge from Chapter 11 protection, it became clear that we had to change Sizzler USA's organizational structure to meet current realities," said Perkins.
